analysis: paired per task (treatment minus control on the same task); report mean delta + per-task deltas + leave-one-task-out; no pooling across tasks without showing concentration
budget: SAME total call cap both arms (recommended: 50, matching the ordinary-agent control history; fallback 40 to match representative H0). Same task deadline, same cost guard. No extra calls for treatment. Feedback delivery itself consumes zero model calls (it rides on the save observation).

control.LibreOffice: same LO recalc/validation/scoring of final submissions
control.invalid: no model-visible new_formula_error (or any error-delta) feedback at any point
control.model_settings: same model, temperature, top_p, max tokens, tool_choice (recommend z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, t=0, matching the ordinary census population)
control.note: The harness MAY compute the input→current-output error delta invisibly after each save for measurement (contact opportunity, would-have-fired), but MUST NOT expose it to the agent. Invisible computation must not change timing/observations.
control.scaffold: ordinary Python/openpyxl coding-agent scaffold (bash + view_xlsx + submit; the current default agent surface). Same system prompt, same instance prompt, same tool schemas.

design: paired task-level A/B: each selected Debugging task runs once under control and once under treatment (same frozen population, Section proposed_discovery_population.json). Pairing is by task, not by trajectory.
forbidden_content: semantic interpretation (no 'you broke X by doing Y')
randomization_and_blinding: run order randomized across arms (seeded, preregistered seed)
scoring is the unmodified official evaluation (blind by construction)
gold-blindness: the feedback path must not open golden workbooks; assert in code review
report_content_factual_concise: error kind per representative (live token: #VALUE!, #REF!, #DIV/0!, Err:NNN, ...)
cell addresses: sampled representatives (<=8 per sheet, <=80 overall, same _summarise rule)
current error value at each representative
report_episodes: AT MOST ONE model-visible diagnostic episode per trajectory in this discovery experiment: the first save producing a nonempty live new_formula_error delta. No repeat on later saves; no submit-stage report in EITHER arm (keeps arms identical except the single write-stage episode; submit-stage would add a second contact mode and a blocking confound).
report_timing_rationale: Historical evidence (live_offline_parity.json, Part 10): submit-only reporting misses never-submit (26/100 in 297), autosubmit-at-cap, and no-workbook trajectories; write-stage fired on 60/100 vs submit-stage 25/100. First-nonempty-write contacts the agent while repair budget remains, and fires nothing on clean saves (no trajectory perturbation without cause).

report_trigger.computation: after a successful workbook save: open input + current output through LibreOffice, recalculate current output (calculateAll then read saved state), compute new_formula_errors(input_map, output_map) with the FROZEN domain function
report_trigger.suppression: saves with zero findings produce NO report and NO observable change (do not perturb the treatment trajectory without cause)
report_trigger.trigger: the FIRST save whose live recalculated input→current-output new_formula_error delta is NONEMPTY

required_telemetry: see proposed_endpoints.json mechanism endpoints; record every element even when the trajectory is censored
sample_size: see proposed_discovery_population.json and next_action.json for N; 8-10 paired tasks recommended pending census completion

treatment.identical_to_control: everything in CONTROL, except the single report episode below. Same total call cap (no extra budget).
treatment.mechanism: world-side factual feedback: mechanically computed list of newly introduced formula errors. States what errors mechanically exist; never proposes the intended formula or infers task semantics.
